title: Vibrational levels of CO
caption: E_n = (n + ½)ħω with ħω = hf = 0.265 eV for f = 6.4 × 10¹³ Hz. The levels are evenly spaced, the lowest is 0.13 eV above the bottom (zero-point energy ½ħω), and every step up absorbs the same 0.265 eV photon, 4.7 μm in the infrared.
alt: Energy-level diagram of five equally spaced levels from 0.132 to 1.191 electronvolts, with upward absorption arrows of 0.265 electronvolts between neighbours.
description: Levels n = 0 to 4 at E_n = (n + ½)ħω: 0.132 eV, 0.397 eV, 0.662 eV, 0.926 eV, 1.191 eV.
The spacing is constant, ħω = 0.265 eV; the lowest level is ½ħω = 0.13 eV (zero-point energy).
Upward arrows show absorption between neighbours; each photon has 0.265 eV and wavelength 4.7 μm in the infrared.
